name: traction-inverter
description: Traction Inverter — 220 kW peak / 120 kW cont, 800 V-class SiC (EconoDUAL 3), ASIL-D-capable (schematic set + BOM)

scripts.build: TSCI_NO_ROUTE=1 tsci build boards/power.tsx --ignore-placement-drc --ignore-routing-drc && TSCI_NO_ROUTE=1 tsci build boards/capbank.tsx --ignore-placement-drc --ignore-routing-drc && TSCI_NO_ROUTE=1 tsci build boards/discharge.tsx --ignore-placement-drc --ignore-routing-drc && TSCI_NO_ROUTE=1 tsci build boards/control-card.tsx --ignore-placement-drc --ignore-routing-drc
scripts.sheets: node calculations/pages.mjs && node calculations/kicad5-gen.mjs && node calculations/kicad5-verify.mjs && node calculations/kicad-sch-gen.mjs && node calculations/kicad-sch-verify.mjs && node calculations/kicad5-print.mjs && node calculations/sheets-to-pdf.mjs
scripts.bom:all: npm run bom && npm run bom:igbt && npm run bom:igbt4 && npm run bom:sic4
scripts.verify: node calculations/erc-audit.mjs && node calculations/design-verify.mjs && node calculations/sim-verify.mjs
